svg.title: Introducing it: six phases
svg.desc: Align, choose the technology, set up, pilot, discover, full lifecycle: what happens in each phase and when it is done, and the measures that show the model works.
svg.text: The framework is agreed first and the technology chosen against it; then set up, piloted, connected to the platforms and run in full.
